source_extracts.label: USPS standard forwarding & change of address
source_extracts.quote: Pay the $1.25 identity verification fee (online COA). Standard mail forwarding lasts 12 months. You can pay to extend mail forwarding for 6, 12, or 18 more months (18 months is the maximum). When forwarding ends, USPS returns mail to sender for 6 months with a label showing the new address. USPS Hold Mail: 3–30 days. Allow at least 7-10 business days for COA to take effect. First-Class, Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail, USPS Ground Advantage forwarded free; Media Mail forwarded but you pay shipping; Marketing Mail not forwarded unless sender paid forwarding postage. (verified 2026-11-20)

source_extracts.label: USPS DMM 507 / forward.htm carrier scope
source_extracts.quote: Your change of address order only changes your mailing address with the Post Office — UPS, FedEx, and DHL are not notified. (verified 2026-11-20)
